scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c green,blue "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:api"
scripts.check: bun --no-script check -p tsconfig.check.json && bun --no-script check -p tsconfig.check.tests.json && bun --no-script check -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/db && bun x drizzle-kit migrate
